inputs.text: Organizers say 8 million attended more than 3,300 “No Kings” events across all 50 states—about one million more than in October—but those are their own figures, not an official count or proof of national consent. A loud protest is still a pressure campaign, not a mandate to override lawful authority. In a country grounded in law and tradition, political power should not belong to whichever faction can claim the biggest crowd.
